title: Bright or dark fringe
description: Essential: The response must correctly state whether point P is a bright or dark fringe based on the path difference.

title: Wavelength calculation
description: Important: The response must correctly calculate the wavelength using the formula λ = c / ν.

title: Path difference ratio
description: Important: The response must compute the ratio n = Δs / λ and interpret its integer or half-integer nature.

title: Number of dark fringes
description: Essential: The response must give the correct integer number of dark fringes between P and O, excluding endpoints.

title: Number of bright fringes
description: Essential: The response must give the correct integer number of bright fringes between P and O, excluding endpoints.

title: Fringe counting logic
description: Important: The response must demonstrate correct reasoning for counting fringes based on the order numbers between P and O.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The response should maintain consistent units (e.g., meters, hertz) throughout calculations.

title: Misinterference condition
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student confuses the conditions for bright (Δs = mλ) and dark (Δs = (m+½)λ) fringes.

title: Endpoint exclusion error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student includes the fringes at points P or O in the count for parts (2) or (3).
